authority.precedence: This extension changes editor defaults, dependent options and coordinate display proposals only; source lineage, analytical semantics and uncertainty remain authoritative.

runtimeIntegration.bootstrap: Load module before its editor/app consumers; hash and public selection updates belong to final release sealing.
runtimeIntegration.implementationStatus: Candidate integration and tests require current evidence; interface listing is not a production certification.

editorPriority: current manually edited or explicitly accepted draft values
saved team overlay values and existing source fields, distinguished by provenance
unique strict-interior coordinate proposal for empty or auto-managed values

sourceFirst.manualSavedConflict: Show current value and coordinate proposal. Change only by explicit Use coordinate suggestion action.

coordinates.pair: Finite numeric latitude in [-90,90] and longitude in [-180,180], both supplied. Preserve source/input precision.
coordinates.blankPartialInvalid: Return missing/invalid state; never Number(empty)->0. Partial/invalid supplied values must be fixed before save.
coordinates.holes: Inside outer ring and outside all holes; a hole edge is boundary.
coordinates.uniquePolicy: Exactly one inside candidate and no boundary/other overlapping candidate for the applicable level. Only strict-interior uniqueness can prefill an empty/auto-managed editor field.
coordinates.boundaryMultiple: Keep candidate set and require a user choice; do not select first or force a UUID.
coordinates.noMatch: Leave unresolved values visible; manual selection/work remains available.
coordinates.candidateIndex: Bounding boxes may reduce candidates only; actual polygon classification decides the proposal.

sources.limitedExamples: prototype/data/real/source-geometries.json contains 18 examples and is not national coverage
sources.geometryIsDisplaySource: Native source/display-simplified geometry; independent legal-boundary verification is false

coordinates.cache: Load required source geometry lazily, share/cache in-flight loads, preserve all candidate ambiguity.
coordinates.draftMarker: D remains unsaved, excluded from analytical Supply.

defaults.freshCountry: No default fine area/province without a valid current filter; no old selected example or forced province.
defaults.freshProvince: Current province only; no arbitrary fine area or invented coordinates.
defaults.freshDistrict: Current province/district filters; fine options via source crosswalk; no arbitrary child selection.
defaults.freshLocation: Current validated reporting UUID and its province; coordinates remain empty unless user supplies them.
defaults.existing: Use record and source values before navigation/filter hints; leave unresolved fields unresolved pending coordinate proposal or explicit choice.
defaults.initialStatus: pending for new records; lookup/prefill never promotes existing/source status
defaults.freshOwnTab: Canonical selected own brand with own relation, pending status.
defaults.freshBrandFilter: Use a recognized current identity as default; derive relation within selected scope.
defaults.noImplicitOwnBrandInAllTab: Without explicit own/filter context, keep unidentified brand/relation unresolved.
defaults.dependentProvince: Refresh fine options and Bangkok Khwaeng versus upcountry LAO label. Keep same valid selection; clear incompatible displayed option only after the user explicitly changes province, retain former draft provenance and explain next step.
defaults.dependentArea: Effective province must equal the province of the selected valid reporting UUID; source adminScope/provenance stays separate.
defaults.candidateFilterEscape: Provide a clear way to select another area; a proposal/filter is not a forced assignment.

brands.source: Current industry supplyCache registry, aliases, selected identity and governed brand metadata; not only loaded Y.pois.
brands.identity: Store canonical ID; retain readable canonical label and original source provenance.
brands.matching: Exact normalized registry name/declared alias; harmless case/whitespace normalization allowed, no fuzzy invention.
brands.oldId: Do not reuse an old ID when the new recognizable label identifies another entity.
brands.ambiguousOrUnrecognized: Remain unresolved; no guessed canonical identity.
brands.relationship: Derive O/C/U using selected own identity and pointRelation/scope policy; keep Non-bank unknown licence/product scope as U.
brands.explicitOwnChoice: Selected Our stores relationship can fill canonical own identity; do not overwrite unrelated saved fields.
brands.nonbankPicker: Top-10 selectable own identities remains separate from full comparator source inventory.

savePolicy.existingUnresolved: Permit notes/evidence/photos and other valid edits without forcing reporting UUID.
savePolicy.newRequired: name && (valid coordinate pair || valid reporting-area UUID)
savePolicy.invalidPartialCoordinates: Reject incomplete or invalid supplied pair with field error; do not silently drop it.
savePolicy.provinceConsistency: Persist effective province from selected valid area, otherwise explicit known province/coordinate proposal with provenance; unresolved is allowed.
savePolicy.geoProposal: Store proposal provenance in draft/team overlay, not immutable source.
savePolicy.event: Only successful committed branch mutation emits the normal before/after event; typing/lookup/filtering has no event.

photoDraft.freshKey: Namespace the temporary new-record photo draft by criteriaContextKey(); branch recordId/route new remains a separate identity.
photoDraft.contextSwitch: No photos carried to another brand/industry/supplyScope; previous context draft remains recoverable.
photoDraft.commit: Move scoped temporary photos to generated branch ID only through existing commit/finalize/rollback flow.
photoDraft.sourcePolicy: Retain existing validation, browser-local storage and privacy limits; no production upload claim.

viewFilters.priority: Saved effective assignment, then usable direct source administrative fields; coordinate candidates only when source membership is unresolved.
viewFilters.unassignedCoordinateMatch: View-only pin/list matching with explicit coordinate-derived label and candidate uncertainty.
viewFilters.boundaryMultiple: Do not turn ambiguous display candidates into exact Supply counts or forced membership.
viewFilters.sourceConflict: Expose mismatch for review; opening/filtering cannot relocate a source UUID.
viewFilters.crosswalk: Many-to-many display links do not duplicate reporting UUIDs/counts.

async.applyOnlyIf: All captured values still match, form remains connected, field is eligible for automatic prefill or user explicitly applies the current proposal.
async.mountAfter: workingForm/restoreWorkingForm has restored manual values and state.
async.failures: Show loading/error/unresolved status without erasing entered fields or applying an older result.
